accepted_claims: The explicit homogeneous ternary quartic is globally a sum of two real quadratic squares.
It is not a finite SOS in Q[x,y,z], even with arbitrary inhomogeneous summands.
It is not in the rational quadratic module of 1-x^2-y^2-z^2 at any finite degree.
The norm, S4 Galois facts, real-pair zeros, six-intersection obstruction, and optional beta identity are valid.
